# Third-party libraries served by the site

Loaded only when a user emails a quote (see `email-quote.js`), to turn the quote
document into a PDF file in the browser. Copied unmodified from npm.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `html2canvas-1.4.1.min.js` | [html2canvas](https://www.npmjs.com/package/html2canvas) 1.4.1, `dist/html2canvas.min.js` | MIT |
| `jspdf-4.2.1.umd.min.js` | [jspdf](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jspdf) 4.2.1, `dist/jspdf.umd.min.js` | MIT |
